notes.title: Moonless Knight release date!
notes.notes:
October 31st 2019.

Yes, in two months.

I could release early October but I rather make sure I polish it up as much as possible. 
It already contains more options and comfort settings than all 3 of my games combined, which is hard as the engine can be a total headache.

Overall this game will feature the widest spectrum of gameplay styles of my games yet, with the absolute most open structure yet. More open than basically any Metroidvania, but not falling over the edge into open world.

Please look forward to the release and make sure to wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029170/Skautfold_Moonless_Knight/

It has been a really hard time for me both due to financial difficulties and struggling with depression, still I feel like this will be by far my best work yet.

notes.title: Into the Fray release date set.
notes.notes:
[b]December 5th.[/b]

[i]Into the Fray[/i] will be leaving Early Access on the 5th of December.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/893610/Skautfold_Into_the_Fray/

The game is a direct sequel to both [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i] and [i]Usurper[/i], and features Hito the 3rd Knight as the protagonist.

The game will receive post launch support in the form of more modes and silly extras, but the release version will already feature a lot of extras. Like the obvious Steam stuff like Achievements and Trading cards.

Once out of EA development on the next game begins immediately, while ItF will receive periodic smaller additions to tie over. No DLC plans. If you are interested in the 4th game in the series you can always pop into our Discord and take a look and have your say, discord users had a lot of influence on me over the last game.

Additionally Christmas will bring a nice surprise regarding [i]Usurper[/i] if everything goes well, as a thank you to all who support my weird series of games with different genres each time.


[h1]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/h1]

[url=https://discord.gg/REKcMkf]Join our Discord![/url]

As always, we strongly recommend that you join our Discord server if you want to be completely up-to-date, or just want to hang out. We are extremely active on there, posting updates and screenshots most days. And if you're worried about spoilers, we have dedicated rooms for those, so they're easy to avoid. It's also super convenient for us to receive bug reports since you can post images, but it's also a direct way to give us suggestions and other comments. 

[h1]OUR STEAM GROUP[/h1]

Alternatively, if you don't use Discord, please consider joining our developer page here on Steam to get the latest news and updates, discuss any [i]Pugware[/i] game, or report issues:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/pugware]Pugware Steam Group[/url]

Thank you all for continuing to support us, and we look forward to seeing you there!
[i]Pugware[/i]

notes.title: Sequel nearing release.
notes.notes:
[b]Into the Fray[/b], the sequel to [b]Shrouded in Sanity[/b] and [b]Usurper[/b] is nearing its completion in Early Access: https://store.steampowered.com/app/893610/Skautfold_Into_the_Fray/

Mandatory story content is nearly finished, and the gameplay is getting polished to a close to final version, an RPG mode was also implemented to make it more for for those who like to create builds.

Final release is expected in 2-3 weeks, with a lot of optional content and a lot of post release content planned, even the possibility of a 2 player local versus mode.
